description: This file defines the 'ExpandedSearch' composable function and several preview functions for different search UI states in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It manages search bar UI, search results display, and previews for loading, empty, category-only, and app list scenarios.

methods.name: ExpandedSearch
methods.description: Composable function that displays a search interface with a top search bar and search results, including previews for different states.

methods.name: AppsSearchLoadingPreview
methods.description: Preview function for loading state of the search UI.

methods.name: AppsSearchEmptyPreview
methods.description: Preview function for empty search results state.

methods.name: AppsSearchOnlyCategoriesPreview
methods.description: Preview function for search results showing only categories.

methods.name: AppsSearchPreview
methods.description: Preview function for search results with apps and categories.
